---
title: PPTX automation using R + officeR
engine: knitr
---

```{r}
# | label: load packages
library(officer)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
#| label: setup R 
source('R/setup.R')
```

```{r}
#| label: get-text
generic_text <- read_yaml("source/generic-text.yml") %>% 
    rapply(double_space, how = "replace") # Do I only want this for print?

city_text_file <- file.path(user_input_dir, "text-files/manual-text.md")
if (file.exists(city_text_file)) {
    city_text <- read_md(city_text_file)
    slide_texts <- merge_lists(city_text, generic_text)
        } else {
    slide_texts <- generic_text
     }

slide_texts <- unlist(slide_texts, recursive = F) %>%
  setNames(str_extract(names(.), "\\.(.*)$", group = T))
```

```{r}
pres <- read_pptx('crp-template.pptx') 
layout <- layout_summary(pres) # print layout slides

```

```{r}
# | label: Title Slide

title <- toupper(paste(city, country, sep = '\n'))
date <- toupper(paste(month.name[lubridate::month(Sys.Date())], 
    lubridate::year(Sys.Date()), sep = ' '))

cover_image <- external_img(fuzzy_read(file.path(output_dir, "maps"), "^aoi.png$", paste))

pres <- add_slide(pres, layout = "Title Slide", master = "Office Theme") %>% 
    ph_with(pres, 
            value = title , 
            location = ph_location_label(ph_label = ('Title'))
            ) %>%
    ph_with(pres, 
            value = date , 
            location = ph_location_label(ph_label = ('Date'))
            ) 

```

```{r}
print(pres, target = "test-slide.pptx") 

```
